chunks: From him, from his father, from Yunus, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
If the people knew what was in the apple, they would not cure their sick ones except by it.
He said, 'And some of them have reported from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Feed the apple to your feverish ones, for there is none of the things more beneficial than the apple.'
ai.seo_question: What are the medicinal benefits of apples according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*’s chapter on the apple, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the fruit’s profound therapeutic value, particularly for fever, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating natural remedies with spiritual wisdom. The narration suggests that the apple’s efficacy is so comprehensive that it could serve as a primary cure if its hidden benefits were fully known, emphasizing the Prophetic emphasis on preventive and natural medicine.

en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Yunus, from the one who mentioned it,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘If the people knew what was in the apple, they would not cure their sick ones except by it’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And some of them have reported from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Feed the apple to your feverish ones, for there is none from the things more beneficial than the apple’.
en.sarwar: 10. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Yunus from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Had people known that which is in apples they would not treat their patients with anything other than apples.’

He (the narrator) has said that certain ones have narrated from abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following: “Feed apples to your people suffering from fever; no other thing is more beneficial than apples.’”
